name: Reco Love Gold Beach
source:
The nameable protagonist of Reco Love is a second-year high school student who attends Mitsumi Academy, a school that consists of every grade from elementary to high school. While attending the “Mitsumi Camp” study and exercise training camp for the two months of summer vacation, he will deepen his bonds with the heroines, and aim for success in confessing his love for the girl he showcases on film at the Mitsumi Festival on the final day of camp.

In this version, the protagonist joins the Ero Film Club of which Seiya Doumoto, who is just barely an erotic knight, is president. While receiving advice from his older sister, Yuina, the protagonist, a story as gorgeous as the evening beach will develop featuring Finnish exchange student and main heroine Mariana Prinsilla, and other characters.

[From [url=http://gematsu.com/2016/04/reco-love-first-details-screenshots]Gematsu[/url]]
translation:
《雷科·洛夫》的主角是一名高中二年级学生，就读于三美学园，这是一所涵盖从小学到高中各个年级的学校。他将在为期两个月的暑假期间参加“三美营”学习和运动训练营，加深与女主角们的感情，并力争在营期最后一天的三美节上成功向电影中的女孩表白。

在这个版本中，主角加入了情色电影俱乐部，而堂本圣也只是一名情色骑士，担任该俱乐部的主席。在接受主人公姐姐尤伊娜的建议的同时，芬兰交换生兼女主角玛丽安娜·普林西拉等角色将展开一个如黄昏海滩般华丽的故事。

[来自[url=http://gematsu.com/2016/04/reco-love-first-details-screenshots]Gematsu[/url]]
